The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] '''Probe-Mate hyperspace pod''' was a streamlined [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]- and [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]]-equipped [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|pod]] used to transport [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Specifications==
[[File:ProbeDroid_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|A [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] schematic, featuring the hyperspace pod]]
The pod was equipped with a fully automated [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain with [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] capabilities. It could carry one droid and land at a specific location, though its internal [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] was limited to one hyperspace jump. It was routinely launched from an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] before entering hyperspace en route to a designated [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

It was 3.4 meters in length with [[Foodstuff/Legends|consumables]] of up to one month; it had a maximum descent speed through [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of 1,200 kph; and it was equipped with a variety of [[Sensor/Legends|sensory]] functions, including a sensor baffler making it difficult to detect. Upon landing on a designated world, the pod was discarded, allowing the Viper probe droid to begin its search.<ref name="GG3" />

Typically, Arakyd marketed the pod at 22,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GG3" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hyperspace_pod_opened.jpg|thumb|250px|A probe droid emerges from a shattered hyperspace pod.]]
Some illustrations of the pod, as seen in sources like ''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]'', differ visually from some portrayals of the vessel.

A few sources mention the [[Predator I]], another hyperspace pod that can carry the Viper droid as well, but has different specifications than the Probe-Mate pod.<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
